items.title: A phase 1 trial of CD123-directed chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy in adults with relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia or blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm
items.abstract: Phase 1 dose-escalation trial of CD123 CAR T cells in 21 treated patients with relapsed/refractory AML or BPDCN, most post-allogeneic transplant: no dose-limiting toxicity, prolonged myelosuppression or GVHD occurred, and 4 of 15 evaluable AML patients achieved complete remission with dose-dependent CAR T-cell expansion.

items.title: A CRISPR-Based Humanized Model Reveals Cooperative Role of STAG2 Loss in Familial GATA2-Deficient MDS Progression
items.abstract: CRISPR/Cas9 engineering of GATA2 deficiency plus acquired STAG2 loss in primary human fetal liver hematopoietic stem cells produced a humanized model recapitulating high-risk GATA2-deficient MDS, with cooperative mutations driving stem cell expansion, inflammatory signaling and myeloid skewing.

items.title: Venetoclax Plus Hypomethylating Agent for 7- Versus 14- Versus 21- Versus 28-Day Cycles in Newly-Diagnosed Acute Myeloid Leukemia: ELN and Mayo Genetic Risk-Stratified Analysis in 540 Patients
items.abstract: Real-world analysis of 540 newly diagnosed AML patients on venetoclax-HMA found no significant survival difference across venetoclax cycle lengths of 7-28 days; outcomes were instead driven by ELN 2024 and Mayo genetic risk, arguing against uniform shortened dosing.

items.title: Incidence, prevalence, and survival outcomes of patients with myeloproliferative neoplasms in the United States: a Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database analysis, years 2000-2021
items.abstract: SEER-17 analysis of 63,242 US patients with MPN (2000-2021) found essential thrombocythemia and polycythemia vera incidence around 1.7-1.8 per 100,000 person-years versus 0.5-0.7 for myelofibrosis and CML, with 5-year relative survival for myelofibrosis improving from 50.9% (2009) to 60.6% (2016) and notable racial and sex variation in outcomes.

items.title: Phase 1, open-label, multicenter study of sovleplenib (HMPL-523) in patients with relapsed or refractory lymphoma
items.abstract: Phase 1 study of the oral SYK inhibitor sovleplenib in 69 patients with heavily pretreated relapsed/refractory lymphoma (recommended phase 2 dose 700 mg daily) showed a 30.2% overall response rate across Hodgkin lymphoma, post-BTKi CLL and peripheral T-cell lymphoma cohorts, with a manageable safety profile and no treatment-related deaths.

items.title: Durable efficacy and manageable long-term safety of lisocabtagene maraleucel in 3L+ FL: 3-year update from TRANSCEND FL
items.abstract: Three-year follow-up of 107 third-line-or-later follicular lymphoma patients treated with liso-cel showed sustained 97% overall and 94% complete response rates, with 36-month overall survival of 86% and a favorable long-term safety profile, including in high-risk subgroups.

items.title: Decade-long persistence of CD19 CAR T cells in B cell lymphomas
items.abstract: Long-term profiling of 4-1BB-costimulated CD19 CAR T cells in 38 non-Hodgkin lymphoma patients found detectable transgene up to 10.1 years post-infusion in a subset of long-term responders, with a progressive shift toward a double-negative effector-memory phenotype and oligoclonal persistence.

items.title: Englumafusp alfa plus glofitamab in B cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma: a phase 1 trial
items.abstract: Phase 1 study adding the CD19-4-1BBL costimulatory molecule englumafusp alfa to glofitamab in 134 patients with relapsed/refractory B-NHL achieved 68.7% overall and 56.6% complete metabolic response in aggressive B-NHL at the recommended schedule, with a safety profile consistent with glofitamab monotherapy.

items.title: Iberdomide plus daratumumab and dexamethasone versus daratumumab, bortezomib, and dexamethasone in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma (EXCALIBER-RRMM): an open-label, randomised, controlled, phase 3 trial
items.abstract: Phase 3 EXCALIBER-RRMM trial in 420 patients with relapsed/refractory myeloma found the CELMoD iberdomide plus daratumumab-dexamethasone roughly doubled MRD-negative complete response versus daratumumab-bortezomib-dexamethasone (41% vs 21%, p<0.0001), supporting iberdomide-based regimens as a new option after one to two prior lines.

items.title: Phase 1 Study of Anito-cel, a d-Domain BCMA CAR T Cell for Refractory or Recurrent Myeloma
items.abstract: Phase 1 study of anitocabtagene autoleucel, a BCMA CAR-T with a novel d-domain binder, in 38 heavily pretreated myeloma patients reported a 100% response rate (79% complete response), 30.2-month median progression-free survival and low-grade CRS/ICANS, with a faster antigen off-rate than dual-VHH binders like ciltacabtagene autoleucel.

items.title: Induction and extended consolidation with daratumumab, cyclophosphamide, bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone in patients with high-risk multiple myeloma (OPTIMUM/MUKnine): 5-year follow-up of a multicentre, externally controlled, phase 2 trial
items.abstract: Five-year follow-up of the OPTIMUM/MUKnine phase 2 trial in 107 high-risk myeloma patients showed intensified quadruplet induction, extended consolidation and daratumumab-lenalidomide maintenance nearly tripled progression-free survival versus a matched Myeloma XI external control (HR 0.32) and roughly halved mortality (HR 0.43).

items.title: Circulating tumor cells identify a disseminated genomic high-risk phenotype within IMS-IMWG 2025 staging in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma
items.abstract: Analysis of 631 myeloma patients found circulating tumor cells refine the 2025 IMS-IMWG genomic staging system, identifying a disseminated genomic high-risk phenotype (CGS high-risk/CTC-high, 12.4% of evaluable patients) with the shortest progression-free survival and supporting minimally invasive risk stratification.

items.title: Venetoclax plus Inotuzumab Ozogamicin for Relapsed and Refractory Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
items.abstract: Phase 1 trial combining venetoclax with inotuzumab ozogamicin in 23 adults with relapsed/refractory CD22+ B-ALL/lymphoblastic lymphoma achieved complete remission in 95.5% of evaluable patients with MRD clearance in 88.9% by flow cytometry, though correlates of relapse included acquired MCL-1 dependence and CD22 antigen escape.

items.title: Refined Continuous Risk Index for Accurately Predicting Outcomes of Patients With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia After Limited-Duration Therapy
items.abstract: A refined continuous individualized risk index incorporating interim, end-of-treatment and 12-month post-treatment MRD (CIRI2-CLL), validated in the CLL13 and CLL14 trials, outperformed CLL-IPI and MRD alone, stratifying patients into 3-year PFS rates of 100%, 70.2% and 10.8% by risk group.

items.title: ELTS Score and Early 'Warning' Define a Two-Stage Risk Framework for Failure-Free Survival in Chronic-Phase CML
items.abstract: Pooled analysis of 710 chronic-phase CML patients on second-generation TKIs found the ELTS score predicts initial treatment failure, but once patients reach the ELN 2025 'Warning' category, only early (within 6 months) attainment of Warning, not baseline ELTS, predicts progression to Unfavorable (HR 7.31).

items.title: A modular gamma-delta TCR-T platform combining KRAS pMHC targeting with re-dosable mRNA engager redirection
items.abstract: Engineering a KRASG12V/HLA-A*11:01-specific alphabeta TCR into gamma-delta T cells, combined with an mRNA-delivered secreted mesothelin-CD3 T-cell engager to cover HLA loss, produced complete responses and prolonged survival in humanized mouse models bearing mixed HLA-positive and HLA-negative KRAS-mutant tumors.

items.title: Comparison of GvHD prophylaxis regimens based on in vivo T-cell depletion (ATG vs. alemtuzumab) in patients with AML undergoing allo-HCT from unrelated donors with intermediate transplant conditioning intensity protocols: a registry study on behalf of the EBMT acute leukemia working party
items.abstract: EBMT registry study of 1545 AML patients receiving unrelated-donor allo-HCT with intermediate-intensity conditioning found ATG-based GVHD prophylaxis gave superior 3-year overall survival (58.3% vs 50.4%) and lower relapse (21.9% vs 28.1%) versus alemtuzumab, despite more acute GVHD.

items.title: Haematopoietic cell transplantation for relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma: a retrospective, registry-based cohort study of 19 498 patients from the EBMT Lymphoma Working Group
items.abstract: EBMT registry study of 19,498 patients with relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma undergoing first auto- or allo-HCT (2010-22) characterized evolving post-transplant outcomes and predictors across more than 600 centers in 53 countries, the largest such cohort reported to date.

items.title: Impact of maintenance therapy on survival after autologous stem cell transplant for multiple myeloma regardless of response: a global analysis
items.abstract: Global WBMT registry analysis of 8,269 newly diagnosed myeloma patients after autologous transplant found 3-year overall survival was higher with lenalidomide (86%), thalidomide (80%) or bortezomib (83%) maintenance than with no maintenance (79%), regardless of depth of response to induction.

items.title: Factor IX Padua AAV gene therapy in adolescents with hemophilia B: a phase 1 trial
items.abstract: Phase 1 trial of AAV-mediated factor IX Padua gene therapy (BBM-H901) in 11 adolescents (aged 12-18) with severe or moderately severe hemophilia B showed no dose-limiting toxicity, mean FIX activity of 41.8 IU/dL at week 52, and annualized bleeding rate falling from 13.9 to 0.5.

items.title: HOPE Kids 2: Phase 3, Randomized Trial of Voxelotor in Children With SCD and Conditional Cerebral Blood Flow Velocities
items.abstract: Phase 3 placebo-controlled HOPE Kids 2 trial of voxelotor in 236 children with sickle cell disease and conditional cerebral blood flow velocity met its primary endpoint (greater CBFV reduction at week 24), but the trial was halted in 2024 after an imbalance in deaths between arms prompted discontinuation of all voxelotor trials.

items.title: Catheter-Directed Thrombolysis in Intermediate-High-Risk Pulmonary Embolism
items.abstract: Randomized trial of 558 patients with intermediate-high-risk pulmonary embolism found catheter-directed thrombolysis plus anticoagulation reduced the 7-day composite of death, PE recurrence or cardiorespiratory decompensation versus anticoagulation alone (0.7% vs 6.8%, RR 0.10), with similar bleeding rates between arms.

items.title: SHR-2004, a Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Targeting Factor XI, for Preventing Venous Thromboembolism After Ovarian Cancer Surgery: A Randomized, Active-Controlled Phase 2 Study
items.abstract: Randomized phase 2 trial in 198 ovarian cancer surgery patients found the anti-factor XI antibody SHR-2004 (twice-monthly dosing) gave numerically lower VTE incidence than enoxaparin-rivaroxaban (12.6% vs 20.2%) with comparable bleeding, supporting phase 3 evaluation of factor XI inhibition for surgical VTE prophylaxis.

items.title: Daraxonrasib for Previously Treated RAS-Mutant Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
items.abstract: Phase 1-2 study of the pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor daraxonrasib in 136 patients with previously treated RAS-mutant NSCLC reported objective response rates of 31-37% across dose levels, with grade 3 or higher adverse events in 54%; the FDA approved daraxonrasib for metastatic pancreatic cancer in September 2026, intensifying interest in its lung cancer data.

items.title: Ivonescimab plus chemotherapy versus placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with advanced EGFR-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer after disease progression on EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy (HARMONi): a multicentre, randomised, double-blind, phase 3 trial
items.abstract: Phase 3 HARMONi trial in 438 patients with EGFR-mutated NSCLC progressing after third-generation EGFR-TKI found adding the PD-1/VEGF bispecific ivonescimab to platinum-pemetrexed chemotherapy improved progression-free survival over chemotherapy alone.

items.title: Atezolizumab in early triple-negative breast cancer: the randomized phase 3 NSABP B-59/GeparDouze trial
items.abstract: Phase 3 NSABP B-59/GeparDouze trial of 1550 patients with stage II-III triple-negative breast cancer found adding atezolizumab to neoadjuvant chemotherapy did not significantly improve event-free survival (HR 0.80, p=0.083), though exploratory analyses suggested benefit in node-positive and basal-like immune-activated tumors.

items.title: Neoadjuvant Anbenitamab and HB1801 in ERBB2-Positive Breast Cancer: A Phase 3 Randomized Clinical Trial
items.abstract: Phase 3 trial in 521 patients with stage II-III ERBB2-positive breast cancer found neoadjuvant anbenitamab (a biparatopic HER2 antibody) plus HB1801 significantly improved total pathologic complete response versus trastuzumab-pertuzumab-docetaxel (62.4% vs 51.2%, p=0.004), with consistent benefit across hormone-receptor subgroups.

items.title: A design approach for bitopic kinase inhibitors
items.abstract: Systematic bitopic-inhibitor design applied to ABL1 produced PonatiLink-2, which matches or exceeds ponatinib's potency against BCR::ABL1 resistance mutants while widening the therapeutic window, outperforming standard-of-care TKIs in mouse models of BCR::ABL1-driven leukemia both alone and combined with dasatinib.

items.title: Unc-51 like kinase 3 (ULK3) contributes to autophagy and cell survival in multiple myeloma
items.abstract: Analysis of 813 myeloma patient samples identified an autophagy gene signature with ULK3 overexpression linked to disease progression; novel ULK3 inhibitors reduced myeloma burden and bone disease in vivo and enhanced proteasome-inhibitor sensitivity in resistant cells.

items.title: Triptolide sensitizes cancer cells to nucleoside DNA methyltransferase inhibitors through inhibition of DCTPP1-mediated cell-intrinsic resistance
items.abstract: A chemical screen identified triptolide and its analogs as potentiators of decitabine by blocking DCTPP1-mediated degradation of the drug's activated metabolite, overcoming DCTPP1-driven resistance to hypomethylating agents used in MDS and AML and nominating DNMTi-triptolide combinations for broader testing.

items.title: Gamma-delta T cells modulate anti-tumor immunity in small cell lung cancer
items.abstract: Single-cell profiling of SCLC identified cytotoxic gamma-delta T cell infiltration associated with improved response to anti-PD-L1 therapy in two practice-changing trials; gamma-delta T cells were redirected to kill SCLC cells by the DLL3-CD3 engager tarlatamab and sensitized by zoledronate, nominating gamma-delta-directed strategies for SCLC.
